ValidationRule.description: Ensure positive number for ctc fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Candidate", OR( Current_CTC__c <= 0, Expected_CTC__c <= 0, Offered_CTC__c <= 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Amounts should be positive and greater than zero for Current CTC, Expected CTC, and Offered CTC.
